body_html:
Tyler comes to us from his small town roots of Casper Wyoming! He started with us in our Northern Colorado office and decided he wanted to enjoy the southern life and relocated to our Atlanta office. Tyler loves entertaining and is one of our highly reviewed true wedding DJs. He has a strict attention to detail and prides himself on taking every measure to ensure your event goes amazing! He loves seeing the reactions and smiles on our clients face at the end of the night when we make the party a success! In his off time, Tyler loves to travel, hike, and spend time with friends!

 

What’s in Tyler’s Headphones: Typically Country, but likes to get down with Party Jams!

What are his go to Floor Fillers: All The Small Things – Blink 182, Cake By The Ocean – DNCE, Low – Flo Rida
